% ADDED figure (2026-11-02): the diagrams of one example box (C6a/C6b/§CA.7); generated by qft-C/tools/c6diag/figs/make_figs.sh
\tikzset{
  fdl/.style={line width=0.8pt, black},
  fdx/.style={circle, fill=black, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=3.6pt},
  fdv/.style={circle, fill=figB, draw=figB, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=5pt},
  fdlab/.style={font=\scriptsize, inner sep=2.6pt},
  fdmom/.style={->, >=Stealth, figO, line width=0.6pt},
}
\tikzset{
  fda/.style={fdl, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.55 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5pt]}}}},
  fdS/.style={font=\small},
}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small]
  % (a) Phi -> phi phi
  \begin{scope}
    \draw[fdl, dashed] (-1.3,0)--(0,0); \draw[fdl] (0,0)--(1.1,0.7); \draw[fdl] (0,0)--(1.1,-0.7);
    \node[fdv] at (0,0){};
    \node[fdlab,above] at (-0.65,0){$\Phi$, $K$};
    \node[fdlab,right] at (1.1,0.7){$\phi$, $p_1$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (1.1,-0.7){$\phi$, $p_2$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (0,-1.5) {(a) $\Phi\to\phi\phi$: $2$ attachments\\[1pt] $i\mathcal M=-2i\mu$; allowed iff $M>2m$};
  \end{scope}
  % (b) phi phi -> Phi
  \begin{scope}[xshift=5.4cm]
    \draw[fdl] (-1.1,0.7)--(0,0); \draw[fdl] (-1.1,-0.7)--(0,0); \draw[fdl, dashed] (0,0)--(1.3,0);
    \node[fdv] at (0,0){};
    \node[fdlab,left] at (-1.1,0.7){$\phi$, $p_1$}; \node[fdlab,left] at (-1.1,-0.7){$\phi$, $p_2$};
    \node[fdlab,above] at (0.65,0){$\Phi$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (0,-1.5) {(b) $\phi\phi\to\Phi$: $-2i\mu$\\[1pt] allowed for $(p_1+p_2)^2=M^2$};
  \end{scope}
  % (c) phi -> Phi phi
  \begin{scope}[xshift=10.2cm]
    \draw[fdl] (-1.2,0)--(0,0); \draw[fdl, dashed] (0,0)--(1.1,0.7); \draw[fdl] (0,0)--(1.1,-0.7);
    \node[fdv] at (0,0){};
    \node[fdlab,above] at (-0.6,0){$\phi$};
    \node[fdlab,right] at (1.1,0.7){$\Phi$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (1.1,-0.7){$\phi$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (0,-1.5) {(c) $\phi\to\Phi\phi$, $\Phi\phi\to\phi$: $-2i\mu$\\[1pt] forbidden, $m<M+m$};
  \end{scope}
  % (d) 0 -> Phi phi phi
  \begin{scope}[xshift=2.2cm, yshift=-3.6cm]
    \draw[fdl, dashed] (0,0)--(1.0,0.7); \draw[fdl] (0,0)--(1.15,0); \draw[fdl] (0,0)--(1.0,-0.7);
    \node[fdv] at (0,0){};
    \node[fdlab,right] at (1.0,0.7){$\Phi$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (1.15,0){$\phi$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (1.0,-0.7){$\phi$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (0.4,-1.5) {(d) $0\to\Phi\phi\phi$, $\Phi\phi\phi\to0$: $-2i\mu$\\[1pt] forbidden};
  \end{scope}
  % (e) 0 -> Phi with phi loop
  \begin{scope}[xshift=8.6cm, yshift=-3.6cm]
    \draw[fdl] (-0.38,0) circle (0.38); \draw[fdl, dashed] (0,0)--(1.2,0); \node[fdv] at (0,0){};
    \node[fdlab,right] at (1.2,0){$\Phi$}; \node[fdlab,left] at (-0.78,0){$\phi$ loop};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (0.2,-1.5) {(e) $0\to\Phi$, $\Phi\to0$: $-i\mu D_F^{(m)}(0)$\\[1pt] forbidden};
  \end{scope}
  \node[fdS] at (5.3,-6.15) {dashed: $\Phi$ (mass $M$); solid: $\phi$ (mass $m$); vertex $-i\mu\cdot1!\,2!=-2i\mu$; a $\Phi$ leg never pairs with a $\phi$ leg};
\end{tikzpicture}
